result.summary: Found 1 significant issue: the promo banner text has very low contrast against its light mint background, making the heading and code details hard or impossible to read. The rest of the layout (header, search, category chips, carousels, restaurant cards, bottom navigation) renders cleanly. Clipped carousel items and the partially visible card at the bottom were excluded as intended behavior.

issues.description: The '3 free deliveries for you' heading and the 'Use code TALLINN3 at checkout · min. order €10' subtext are white text on a very light mint green background. The contrast ratio is far below WCAG AA minimums, so the key promotional information is barely legible.
issues.suggestion: Use dark text (for example, the dark green or near-black used elsewhere in the app) on the mint background, or darken the banner background so white text reaches at least a 4.5:1 contrast ratio.
